description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ByteDance is hiring a Software Engineer to gather user requirements and build high-quality software that meets coding standards. The role also supports software verification, documentation, deployment, and evaluation of user feedback.
Software Engineer gathering requirements, coding and deploying standards-compliant software, documenting specifications, and evaluating user feedback

Responsibilities:
• Gather user requirements and write code in various programming languages to build high-quality and fully performing software that complies with coding standards
• Collaborate with Senior Engineers to develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
• Produce software specifications and assist the team in determining operational feasibility
• Develop flowcharts, layouts, and documentation to assist the team in identifying software requirements and solutions
• Deploy software programs and evaluate user feedback
• Comply with project plans and industry standards

Requirements:
• Must have a Master's degree or a foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering (any), Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, and 1 year of related work experience; OR a Bachelor's degree or a foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering (any), Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, and 3 years of related work experience
• Of the required experience, must have 1 year of experience in each of the following:
• Developing software using Java, Go, C++, JavaScript, Ruby, or Python
• Maintaining and debugging software services
• Provisioning servers using Linux operating systems
• Deploying and managing applications using containerized tools; and
• Version control of codebase using Pipeline, Bash, or Git
